prize.text: $25,000 for the Series competition (previously Professional) and $5,000 for the Single Image competition (previously Open), plus Sony equipment
prize.quote: you could win $25,000, a solo exhibition, a range of top Sony Digital Imaging equipment ... you could win $5,000, a range of top Sony Digital Imaging equipment

freeEntry.text: Free to enter, confirmed by the rules themselves; up to three images free
freeEntry.quote: 1.2.1 The Competition is free to enter. ... 3.5 Each Entrant can submit up to three images for free.

deadline.text: Single Image and Youth close 2027-01-05 16:00 GMT; Series closes 2027-01-12 16:00 GMT; Student closes 2026-11-27 16:00 GMT
deadline.quote: 5 January 2027 16:00 GMT Single Image and Youth competition close

eligibility.text: Open to members of the public; under-16s need guardian consent; images must be taken in 2026 and be the entrant's own work
eligibility.quote: Open to all members of the public. Under 16 requires guardian consent. Images taken in 2026; sole owner/author required.

aiPolicy.text: Computer-generated images cannot be the origin of an entry; manipulation must be described
aiPolicy.quote: Computer generated content cannot be the origin of the Entry.

payout.quote: Payment method not described on the overview page.

summary: Free to enter with cash prizes of $25,000 and $5,000 and deadlines in November 2026 and January 2027 - one of the few genuinely free, large, open-to-anyone cash prizes in the ledger.
flags: Requires original photography: computer-generated content cannot be the origin of an entry.
Free image allowance is three images; extra image bundles are paid add-ons.
